cards.claim: Smooth learning rate schedules outperform constant rates and calendar-based decay schedules
cards.conditions: Image classification (MNIST, Fashion-MNIST, CIFAR-10); 4 architecture families (fully connected, convolutional, recurrent, residual); 72 runs; fixed optimizer, data pipeline, and evaluation protocol
cards.effect: 2.5 percentage points on CIFAR-10 dataset mean; margins grow with task difficulty
cards.evidence: Comparative empirical benchmark across multiple datasets and architectures
cards.quote: Schedules that fall smoothly from peak to floor beat the constant rate and calendar-based decay by margins that grow with task difficulty, reaching 2.5 points of dataset mean on CIFAR-10.

cards.claim: BrachistoneLR, cosine annealing, and warmup-cosine schedules achieve statistically indistinguishable performance
cards.conditions: CIFAR-10; one seed per configuration; residual networks and other architectures tested
cards.effect: Performance gap within 0.06 accuracy points and 0.17 of mean rank; insufficient statistical power to separate with single seed
cards.quote: BrachistoneLR, cosine annealing, and warmup-cosine lie within 0.06 accuracy points and 0.17 of a mean rank, which one seed per configuration cannot separate.

cards.claim: The shape of a learning rate schedule matters more than its specific parameterization
cards.conditions: Image classification across MNIST, Fashion-MNIST, CIFAR-10; 4 architecture families
cards.effect: The choice to use a smooth schedule is more consequential than tuning milestones, decay factors, warmup length, or restart periods
cards.evidence: Empirical observation from comparative benchmarking study
cards.quote: the shape of a schedule matters more than its parameterization, that the choice of whether to use a smooth schedule matters more than the choice among them

cards.claim: Terminal-rate effects of learning rate schedules decay rapidly with epoch budget and are negligible for practical training horizons
cards.conditions: Asymptotic analysis of schedule endpoints; short to moderate training horizons

cards.evidence: Theoretical analysis; empirical observation that the 1-epoch terminal-rate shift is only worth attention over short horizons
cards.quote: the terminal-rate distinction is worth attention only over short horizons.
